query_text: Transfer money to my savings account

messages.content: Transfer money to my savings account

message.content:
To transfer money to your **savings account**, log in to your bank’s **online banking** or **mobile app** and choose the **Transfer** option, then select the account you want to move money **from** and your **savings account** as the account **to**.[1][3][4][5][7]

- In many banks, you’ll find this under **Transfers**, **Pay & Transfer**, or a similar menu.[1][3][7]
- You can usually make a **one-time transfer** or set up **recurring transfers** to savings.[3][4][5]
- Transfers between your own accounts are often processed the **same day** or the **next business day**, depending on the bank and cutoff times.[1][7]
- If your savings account is at a different bank, you may need to add it as an **external account** first, which can require the account number and routing number and a small verification deposit.[1][5]

If you want, I can also give you the exact steps for a specific bank or help you figure out whether you mean an internal transfer or a transfer to a different bank.
